security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives from Nuxt documentation syntax and examples. However, one inline configuration example could enable script injection when configuration contains untrusted script-closing text. No prompt injection, secret exfiltration, or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Inline configuration is serialized into a script block without HTML-safe escaping.
remediation.suggestion: Use an HTML-safe serializer that escapes less-than characters, or place data in a non-executable JSON element and parse it safely.

content.user_title: Build Nuxt Apps with Framework Guidance
content.value_statement: Nuxt projects require accurate choices across routing, data fetching, SSR, and server routes. This skill gives concise Nuxt 4 guidance for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Explains Nuxt 4 directory conventions, aliases, and srcDir layout.
Guides file-based routing, dynamic routes, middleware, and route validation.
Covers useFetch, useAsyncData, custom fetchers, caching, and interceptors.
Describes server routes, middleware, Nitro plugins, and deployment targets.
Summarizes modules, layers, hooks, rendering modes, SSR, and hydration practices.
limitations: It provides reference guidance and does not modify projects by itself.
Examples are illustrative and must be adapted to each application.
It may lag behind Nuxt releases after the documented generation date.
It does not replace official documentation or a security review.

use_cases.title: Plan a Nuxt 4 migration
use_cases.description: Map app directories, aliases, routing files, and composables to current Nuxt 4 conventions.

use_cases.title: Implement server routes
use_cases.description: Choose server API patterns, middleware, Nitro plugins, and deployment behavior for a Nuxt application.

use_cases.title: Review SSR data fetching
use_cases.description: Evaluate useFetch, useAsyncData, lazy fetching, caching, and hydration guidance before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Nuxt Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: I am building a Nuxt 4 page. Explain which Nuxt features I should use for routing, layout, data fetching, and state.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Data Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design the data fetching flow for a Nuxt product page with SEO data, related items, loading states, and error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Fix SSR Behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Nuxt SSR issue. Identify possible context leaks, hydration mismatches, invalid composable usage, and safer alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Author a Nuxt Module
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through creating a Nuxt module with typed options, runtime templates, hooks, composables, and compatibility requirements.

output_examples.input: How should I fetch data for a Nuxt article page?
output_examples.output: Use blocking fetch for the article content when SEO matters. Load comments or recommendations lazily so navigation stays responsive.

output_examples.input: Where should I place a reusable auth helper in Nuxt 4?
output_examples.output: Place client composables under the app composables directory. Put server-only auth helpers under server utilities or shared server code.

output_examples.input: What should I check before deploying a Nuxt app?
output: Confirm the rendering mode for important routes.
Check Nitro preset and environment variables.
Run build and preview before publishing.

best_practices: State the Nuxt version and project structure before asking for implementation guidance.
Ask for SSR, client-only, and hybrid rendering tradeoffs when routes behave differently.
Review generated examples for application-specific security, validation, and error handling.
anti_patterns: Do not copy placeholder URLs, secrets, or route names without adapting them.
Do not use client-only browser libraries during SSR without guards or lazy loading.
Do not treat simplified examples as complete authentication or authorization logic.

faq.question: Does this skill support Nuxt 4?
faq.answer: Yes. The reference material is written for Nuxt 4 conventions, including the app directory and updated aliases.

faq.question: Can it create a full Nuxt application?
faq.answer: It can guide implementation, but it does not scaffold or edit files unless the host AI tool performs those actions.

faq.question: Does it cover server routes?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes server API routes, middleware, Nitro plugins, event context, and deployment references.

faq.question: Does it include data fetching guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers useFetch, useAsyncData, custom fetchers, lazy fetching, interceptors, and SSR request headers.

faq.question: Is it a security auditing skill?
faq.answer: No. It includes framework guidance, but application security decisions still need project-specific review.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
